fair_value_reason: NTM EBITDA at Sep-2027 of ~$440M (time-weighted 2027/2028 consensus of ~$500M less 12% for the ramp record) x 20x = $8.8B, plus ~$1.15B of claims at Sep-2027 (cash $1.45B less $0.19B non-convert debt, less ~$0.75B burn, plus $0.336B warrant cash, plus ~$0.30B capped call), over 239.3M FD shares = $41.6. The market-multiple cross-check (17.4x today on $540M 2028 consensus, plus $1.15B) = $44.1. Weighted about 2:1, this gives $42.5. It is above the agents' $40.3 mean because agent_3's drop comes from removing a method rather than from new evidence, and agent_4's competition discount fails a check. It is below my round-1 $44, which sat at the top of my own range and used an overstated $9.8B / 18x current EV.
supervisor_summary: In round 2 the five fair values fell to $36.5-42.5 (mean $40.3), and the ladders moved about 2 points lower in the middle. The convergence is largely the agents adopting my round-1 inputs rather than independent agreement. Fact-checks show the drop is partly real: the ramp is lagging (Q2 output 840t, below Q1) and consensus has been cut. It is also partly over-correction: agent_3 deleted a method, agent_4's DLA 'lost orders' were two small sole-source awards to others, and my own round-1 contracted value ($22-28) and current EV ($9.8B) were too high. I reconcile fair value at $42.5, keep the thesis break at $29 and nudge the middle of the ladder up under a point. The 10 Jan 2027 China cliff and a possible 2027 financing (a $500M minimum-cash covenant against heavy 10X capex) are the in-horizon events that matter.
key_drivers: The 10 Jan 2027 expiry of China's suspended export controls is the main two-sided binary. The 1 Jan 2027 DFARS mine-to-magnet rule is a structural support, not a dated price event.

The ramp is behind: NdPr output was 2,599t in FY2025, then 917t in Q1-26 and 840t in Q2-26, while the 2027 consensus EBITDA of $377.7M requires about 3x the ~$114M run rate. Most current EBITDA is PPA income (62% in Q2).

Capital structure: ~239M FD shares, ~$1.15B of net claims at Sep-2027, and heavy 10X capex against a $500M minimum-cash covenant until EBITDA reaches $400M or the June-2027 test, which raises the risk of a 2027 financing.
Valuation: EV ~$9.4B is ~17.4x 2028 consensus ($540M). Reconciled fair value is $42.5 against a $47.29 close, so the price carries a policy and scarcity premium of about $5.
Two-way flow: 23% short interest, CEO sales of ~$78M at $64-71 earlier in 2026, and a sell-side mean (~$74-76) that lags and is being cut.
